verdict.line: You lose if Volibear lands his Q stun into W before you hit level 3 and have no E to answer; you win if you survive that window and only commit your all-in once his R is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by ultimate timing, not raw stats: Volibear's R (Stormbringer) can land directly on your Vessel/tentacle setup and blunt the swarm that is Illaoi's entire win condition, so the OP.GG tip to only engage with your own R when his is down is the single most important rule in the lane. Before level 3 you have no tool to answer his Q (Thundering Smash) dash-stun into W (Frenzied Maul) double-mark trade, which is why the head-to-head sits at 49.6% over 123 games despite Illaoi holding both the lane-dominance and solo-kill edge in the wider matchup data. Win the early stun window and this flips hard in your favor once Test of Spirit comes online.

theirWindow.when: His Q and E are both ready
theirWindow.what: Thundering Smash (300 range, CD 12-10s) dashes to stun the first thing he hits, and he'll follow with Frenzied Maul applied twice for bonus damage and a heal while Sky Splitter (1200 range, 16s CD) slows and shields him from range to force the stand-and-trade. Don't contest without Test of Spirit's vessel already up to punish back.

yourWindow.when: His R is down or just used
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Force a Vessel with Test of Spirit (E), then use Leap of Faith (R) for full uncontested tentacle value, chaining Tentacle Smash (Q) and Harsh Lesson (W) into him since he has no leap left to disrupt the swarm.

start.why: Measured at 51.2% win over 82 games, and the lane sustain plus early AD matters since you can't out-trade his Q-stun combo until Test of Spirit comes online at 3.

boots.why: 48.1% win rate and the pick rate leader (54.2%) — tenacity shortens how long his Q (Thundering Smash) stun locks you down, and the magic resist answers his on-hit passive damage.

core.why: Highest-performing build path in the data (60% win over 10 games); the armor shred compounds with every tentacle and Harsh Lesson proc you land.
Adds the slow-on-cast that keeps him in Tentacle Smash range after you've ripped his spirit, denying the kite-away he needs post-Q.
Survivability against his all-in R (Stormbringer) burst, and the tenacity bonus against his Q stun stacks with Mercury's Treads.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-winrate page in the data (46.7%); the permanent health growth and heal-on-proc let you win the extended Test of Spirit trades instead of losing short all-ins to his Q-into-W burst.

summoners.why: Highest-winrate combo measured (54.2%) — Exhaust directly neutralizes his Q-stun-into-W all-in and softens Stormbringer's burst, while Flash lets you reset Test of Spirit range or dodge Sky Splitter.

playing.title: Bait his Q before trading
playing.detail: Thundering Smash only has 300 range, so stand just outside it and punish the moment it's down with Harsh Lesson instead of letting him dash in on his terms.

playing.title: Disengage after one Frenzied Maul
playing.detail: His W marks on the first cast and only deals bonus damage plus heals him on the second cast on the same mark — back off after the first hit to deny the follow-up.

playing.title: Force Test of Spirit on commits
playing.detail: From level 3, use E (CD 16-12s) the instant he commits to a trade; the spirit echoes damage back and turns him into a Vessel if he tries to disengage.

playing.title: Respect the Sky Splitter skillshot
playing.detail: His E (1200 range, 16s CD) slows and shields him if he's caught in it — don't facecheck brush or river once it's been down long enough to be back up.

playing.title: Hold your ult for his R cooldown
playing.detail: Only commit Leap of Faith when Volibear's Stormbringer is already spent, since his R can land on your tentacle swarm and blunt the whole engage.

playing.title: Chain W into Q on marked targets
playing.detail: Once he's a Vessel or mid-Test of Spirit, stack Harsh Lesson into Tentacle Smash back-to-back to maximize tentacle procs and the healing they give you.

playing.title: Play for the early solo-kill window
playing.detail: Illaoi holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup overall — look to freeze and force isolated trades at levels 3-5, before his ultimate comes online at 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Volibear when he uses (E) to engage. Volibear can use (R) to counter the tentacles from [R] after reaching level 6, so engage only when (R) is on cooldown.
